hotels.title: South Samoa Family-Owned Beachfront Oasis with Daily Tropical Breakfast, Nightly Drinks & A$150 Dining Credit
hotels.description: Let lush palms and white sands whisk you away, all as you enjoy the warm hospitality of this family-owned hideaway, hosted by the same custodians of the land for more than 1,000 years. Onsite eateries cater your stay on Samoa's south island - a poolside cafe with international favourites and the signature restaurant with fresh local seafood. You're also invited to cool off with tiki drinks at Rock Pool Bar and relax at the Lomi Wellness Spa or by any of the four pools. The glimmering beachfront of this resort - made famous by the 1950s Hollywood classic of the same name - is the stuff of dreams. Your stay on Upolu Island includes a two-hour village tour, taking you to all of the filming locations from the 70-year-old movie, sharing insights into old traditions and visiting a local primary school to introduce you to the charm of local life.
